name: Vampiric Change Simulator
source:
You've completed your transformation from human to vampire and the person responsible— your sire— is checking in on you. That's it. It's DEFINITELY just about having become a new vampire. Not a metaphor for anything else.

[From [url=https://fizcatgames.itch.io/vampiricchangesimulator]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚完成从人类到吸血鬼的转变，赐予你初拥的那位吸血鬼，正过来看看你适应得怎么样。就这样。这故事千真万确只是在讲刚变成吸血鬼这回事。绝对没有别的隐喻。

（来源：[url=https://fizcatgames.itch.io/vampiricchangesimulator]itch.io[/url]）
